description: Change of use from HMO C4 to Sui Generis (Large HMO)
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12pt">The proposed development, by reason of the excessive number of occupiers that it accommodates, poor outlook and loss of privacy from bedrooms 3 and&nbsp; 4, and inappropriate stacking, represents an overly intensive use of the site which would result in substandard living accommodation for existing and future occupiers of the site, and would be likely to give rise to undue levels of disturbance and noise resulting in a detrimental impact on the amenities of future occupiers and adjoining properties. The proposal is therefore contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policies D3.D(7), D3.D(9), and D3.D(10) and D14 of The London Plan (2021), policies GR1, HO10 of the Harrow local Plan 2021-2041.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">The proposal
would be out of character with the existing, surrounding family homes within
the immediate vicinity of the application site. The proposal would therefore
result in a detrimental impact to the character of the area. The proposal is
therefore contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policies
D3.D(7), D3.D(9), and D3.D(10) and D14 of The London Plan (2021), policies HO10 of the Harrow local Plan 2021-2041.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-font-kerning:0pt;mso-ligatures:
none;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-GB;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">The principle
of the proposed conversion of the property into a 7-bedroom, 7-person Sui
Generis House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) is unacceptable due to the site’s
poor accessibility to public transport and essential services, The proposal is
therefore contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), policies
D3.D(7), D3.D(9), and D3.D(10) and D14 of The London Plan (2021), policies,
HO10 of the Harrow local Plan 2021-2041.</span></p>
